svg.title: Alumina Refinery
svg.text: Each item stands for the train it belongs to: two precipitators for a tank farm of twelve.
Soda leaving chemically bound in the residue is replaced by the make-up on S-943. Soda dissolved in the residue's entrained liquor is what the washing on TH-902 recovers.
Lime burning, causticisation, oxalate removal, residue disposal and product cooling are not in this set of drawings.
